Those Neanderthal traits that were beneficial in Ice Age Europe, such as light skin, straight hair, and certain mental traits, were preserved, but we also preserve an anatomical build more similar to the Africans in some important ways (the Neanderthals' stocky builds required more nutrition for survival), and we also preserved certain African social traits such as the tendency to live in larger groups than our Neanderthal ancestors did.

Evolution is powerful, but in order for it to yield a given species it needs the right natural selection pressures. The confluence of African and Neanderthal DNA in Ice Age Europe eventually saw the savagery of Africans negatively selected for and violence inducing MAOA alleles and similar such alleles became less common over time.

With modern technology, however, the selection pressures will be quite different. A twisted, mongrelized race with an average IQ of 90 could scrape by, with a low standard of living and with considerably less inspiration, and they would use GMOs and modern surgical techniques to avoid any evolutionary conditions that would eventually bring them to the former glory of the Whites who invented these things.

The Hijra or Hijrah (Arabic: هِجْرَة‎), also romanized as Hegira and Hejira, is the migration or journey of the Islamic prophet Muhammad and his followers from Mecca to Yathrib, later renamed by him to Medina, in the year 622 CE.[1] In June 622 CE, after being warned of a plot to assassinate him, Muhammad secretly left his home in Mecca to emigrate to Yathrib, 320 km (200 mi) north of Mecca, along with his companion Abu Bakr.[4] Yathrib was soon renamed Madīnat an-Nabī, literally "the City of the Prophet", but an-Nabī was soon dropped, so its name is "Medina", meaning "the city".[5]
